description.value: You wrench every loose object and creature within a wide radius into a churning vortex of force. Each creature of your choice within a 20-foot radius of a point you choose within range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d8 force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 6
